title: Home keeps its tabs: Merge Workspace Into refuses Home on either side and a page item as the destination; another workspace's tab still moves to a new workspace
preconditions: a fresh launch: one window, one terminal workspace, Home available
converted from scripts/cmux-next/home-tabs-stay-e2e.py, which stays; tests/oracle/corpus/e2e/_scripts-094.json links them

steps.note: a second terminal tab in the launch workspace; created/0 is the tab (NewTabRequest names the tab before its terminal)
the state the move starts from: one workspace, two tabs
script row 'Move Tab to New Workspace on another workspace's tab': it runs and makes one more workspace
a plain terminal workspace, the other side of the merges; created/0 is its public ws_ id (CreateWorkspaceRequest)
Home is shown and its workspace is set up; the settle barrier bounds the setup
debug.home names Home's workspace (home_workspace.workspace, the model id the action target resolver takes)
script row 'Merge Home into another workspace': both ids resolve, so the merge handler itself refuses (RefusalStrings.homeKeepsItsTabs), not the target lookup
script row 'Merge a workspace into Home': the merge refuses it (WorkspaceVerbStrings.mergeIntoHome)
script row 'Merge a workspace into the App Store': the App Store is a page item, not a workspace, so the target lookup refuses it

invariants: the workspaces and their tabs in topology at refused equal those at home: the three refused merges move no tab and close no workspace (script: 'Home keeps its tabs; no workspace closes')
moved has one workspace more than two-tabs and the same tab count: the tab moved, it was not copied
history at refused is empty: no refused merge closed a workspace into the closed history
every mutation has one receipt or one typed error (I1)
ids stay stable unless the step created or closed them (I2)
teardown: quit the tagged app the run started
verify its debug socket is gone
untested: Move Tab to New Workspace and Move Tab to New Window on Home's own tab (#18829): no step reply names Home's tab id (debug.home lists only its tab kinds), and a snapshot value cannot be a step target
Merge the App Store into a workspace: the App Store would be the action's target, and driver_app refuses a named fixture identity as a target until seeded handles reach the app (p15-oracle-180)
